applications.title: Luxury Residential Bathrooms & Ensuites
applications.subtitle: Where tactile precision meets daily ritual and serene moisture-resistant resilience
applications.description: Bathroom environments demand the highest standard of metallurgy. High humidity, temperature swings, and chemical cleaning agents cause lesser hardware to pit and peel. SIDDI bathroom accessories and towel rails are engineered with multi-layer PVD plating over solid forged brass and marine grade 316 stainless steel, ensuring spotless performance across years of daily use.
hardwareHighlights: Concealed anti-spin towel bars rated for daily use
Solid brass wall mounts with moisture-tight silicone gaskets
Matching matte black, brushed brass, and polished chrome finishes across all fittings

applications.title: Bedrooms & Interior Passage Doors
applications.subtitle: Whisper-quiet acoustic performance, weighted hand-feel, and flush architectural aesthetics
applications.description: Internal doors are the primary tactile transition points in any home. SIDDI lever handles and magnetic mortise locks eliminate harsh latch clicks and vibration, creating seamless, silent acoustic transitions between bedrooms, dressing rooms, and private studies.
hardwareHighlights: Silent magnetic latches that engage without frame strike friction
Concealed 3D adjustable hinges for completely flush door leaves
Ergonomic solid lever sets with dual torsion return springs

applications.title: Boutique Hotels & High-End Hospitality
applications.subtitle: Cycle-tested durability calibrated to withstand rigorous guest turnover while maintaining five-star elegance
applications.description: Hotels require hardware that combines architectural design purity with extreme mechanical longevity. From entrance pivot pulls to heavy-use robe hooks and card-key compatible mortise locksets, SIDDI hardware is tested across hundreds of thousands of cycles to exceed commercial contract standards.
hardwareHighlights: Corrosion and scratch-resistant PVD physical vapor deposition finishes
Tamper-resistant concealed fixings with proprietary key access

applications.title: Executive Offices & Commercial Workspaces
applications.subtitle: Crisp architectural lines, ADA/accessible compliance, and robust security integration
applications.description: Corporate headquarters and creative agency studios demand hardware that communicates professionalism and intentionality. SIDDI provides oversized entrance pulls, heavy-duty floor pivots, and minimalist cabinet hardware tailored for conference rooms, executive suites, and acoustic glass partitions.
hardwareHighlights: Back-to-back pull handles for full-height architectural pivot doors
Hydraulic floor spring controls with 90-degree hold-open functionality
Recessed edge pulls for streamlined executive storage millwork

applications.title: Architectural Renovations & Custom Millwork
applications.subtitle: Unifying hardware finishes across custom joinery, custom vanities, and existing heritage or modern doors
applications.description: Great renovation projects hinge on cohesive finishing touches. Designers frequently face mismatched metallic tones across suppliers. SIDDI solves this with coordinated finish suites across door handles, cabinet pulls, bathroom hooks, and accessories.
hardwareHighlights: Identical metallic finish matching across door and joinery elements
Standardized hole center spacing for easy replacement upgrades
Comprehensive technical specification sheets for joinery shop drawings
